preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call functions that modify state variables

exploit_hint: The vulnerability is about unused variables that create code clutter but don't directly enable financial theft. The '_default' CustomTaxPeriod struct is declared but never used - all fee modifications happen via '_base' struct. As owner, call setAllFeesToZero() to demonstrate the ability to modify fee structures, which shows the codebase has unnecessary complexity. The exploit doesn't require complex transactions, just owner privilege demonstration.
